Randevu:root{--bg:#0f1014;--card:#171920;--c2:#1f222c;--bd:rgba(201,162,39,.35);--gold:#C9A227;--gl:#E5C158;--tx:#f5f3ef;--mt:#a1a1aa;--ok:#22c55e}*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font-family:sans-serif;line-height:1.5}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.top{max-width:1100px;margin:auto;padding:16px 20px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.btn{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--bd);background:rgba(201,162,39,.1);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;color:var(--tx)}.wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:24px auto 50px;padding:0 20px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:320px 1fr;gap:22px}@media(max-width:860px){.wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:18px;padding:22px}.av{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid var(--gold)}.cg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:6px;text-align:center;margin-top:10px}.day{aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:var(--c2);color:var(--tx);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}.day.sel{background:var(--gold);color:#111}.day:disabled{opacity:.25;cursor:not-allowed}.sg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:10px}.slot{padding:10px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--bd);background:rgba(201,162,39,.08);color:var(--tx);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}.slot:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--gold);color:#111}.slot:disabled{opacity:.35;text-decoration:line-through;cursor:not-allowed}.fg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:12px}@media(max-width:600px){.fg{grid-template-columns:1fr}}input,select,textarea{width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:var(--c2);color:var(--tx);font-family:inherit}.pri{width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:12px;border:none;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--gl));color:#111;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:12px}.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.82);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;z-index:999}.mcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:18px;max-width:760px;width:100%;max-height:85vh;overflow:auto;padding:22px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;margin-top:10px}th,td{padding:8px;border-bottom:1px
